mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d SPX returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals a weakening labor market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signal a severe economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to dual stress on monetary policy and labor markets.
regime_hint: dual stress: high rates and high unemployment
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS>5.0% and UNRATE>4.0%, or the interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has a positive coefficient in a regression of 20d returns on FEDFUNDS, UNRATE, and their interaction (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS > 700,000 million) during a late-cycle expansion regime signals overvaluation and impending market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 700000 during a late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC between RSAFS and 20d returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1500 thousand units) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC between HOUST and 60d returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) without corresponding monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS <= 5.0%) signals policy inaction and loss of confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL>310 and FEDFUNDS<=5.0, or the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has a positive coefficient in a regression (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 158,000 thousand) signals a tight labor market and robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 158000, or Rank IC between PAYEMS and 5d returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
